For my Sunshineee

If I could give you one thing...

If I could give you one thing in this world, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes.

Maybe then you'd understand how special you are to me.

No matter how far apart we are, I hope you always remember that somewhere in this world, there's someone who is always cheering for you, thinking of you, and choosing you.

You're my favorite person, my cute little sunshine, and my favorite fairytale.

Congratulations again on your Dean's List, Sunshineee. This is one more reminder of how capable you are and how many beautiful things are still waiting for you.

I'm proud of you, I'm cheering for you, and I'm grateful that I get to share this little adventure with you.
